parameters.query:
INSERT INTO chinmay_astro.pending_users (phone_number, contact_name, created_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (phone_number) DO UPDATE 
  SET contact_name = EXCLUDED.contact_name,
      created_at = NOW()
RETURNING phone_number
